reference_protocol.description: A new evaluation may reproduce the archived step-6499 protocol. This does not establish the original 20B-100B protocol.
reference_protocol.code_scoring: archived corrected official EvalPlus with isolation probes
reference_protocol.dataset_hashes: Read from the actual archived evaluator manifests; do not invent or omit during replay.
reference_protocol.score_comparison: Only compare under matching data, prompt, scoring and decoding manifests. Approximate reported values retain their original precision.

required_publication_material: model weight SHA-256 computed from the actual checkpoint
checkpoint metadata and actual consumed-token counter, with lineage information where available
prompt/shot count, precision, decoding, stops and extraction rules
all problem IDs, generated outputs or choice scores, and outcome flags
summary metrics recomputed from recorded outcomes
actual runtime start/end, command, exit status, package versions and GPU configuration
code-execution isolation receipt and scoring limits
original raw stdout/stderr and any failed task records
byte-preserving artifact manifest; redaction mappings only when necessary
remarks: The 6.2B label is not interchangeable with step 6499 (~6.82B). No independent 6.2B log is manufactured.
Lost weights prevent a new evaluation of that exact historical model; retain unresolved entries rather than substitute a neighboring checkpoint.
